svg.text: "Give me five key papers on X, with DOIs." Then check each one.

g.text: 1. Berg, Haddad & Moreau (2018). Seasonal variation in ... J. Plant Res. doi:10.1000/jpr.0412
exists, and it is the paper described
2. Lindqvist & Okafor (2020). A cold-storage effect on ... Plant Cell Env. doi:10.1000/pce.7781
DOI does not resolve; no such paper in PubMed or the journal
3. Tanaka et al. (2016). Dormancy and germination ... New Phytol. doi:10.1000/nph.2290
DOI works, but leads to a different paper by different authors
4. Rossi & Patel (2021). Light quality and seed vigour ... Seed Sci. Res. doi:10.1000/ssr.1187
real paper, but it does not say what the summary claims

svg.text: Each line looks equally confident. Only checking tells them apart.
illustrative: made-up references with the example DOI prefix 10.1000
